resources.string: Photos are sent to Plinth’s server and processing provider only for operations you start. Uploads are kept on our server for up to 1 hour and results for up to 24 hours. Report notes are kept until you delete your data with DELETE /data. The provider’s own retention is outside our control.
The output stays on this device. Only its job reference, your reason and optional note are sent.
